questions.answer: The train is really cheap especially in weekends. So you can explore the smaller cities around Melbourne which is really nice way to see the country without using a lot of money. I can recommend going when there is a farmers market which a lot of the cities have.

What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Don’t live on campus it is expensive for small rooms.
Go to some events in the beginning otherwise it will be hard to find people.
Use the free food opportunities.
